title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Twenty–Seven Billion Pesos (27,000,000,000.00) to Fund the Fourth–Year Implementation of the Salary Increases Authorized By Joint Resolution No. 1, Series of 1994, and for Other Purposes

text.en: Funding for Other Personnel. – For government–owned and controlled corporations, the amount needed to implement the aforesaid salary adjustment for their personnel shall come from their respective corporate funds. For local government units, the amount needed for the purpose shall be charged to their respective local funds.

Basis of Retirement Benefits. – Government personnel who will compulsorily retire prior to November 1, 1997 shall be entitled to retirement benefits based on the full rate of implementation under Section 1(2) hereof.
Prohibition. – The salary adjustment funded herein shall not benefit the President, the Vice–President and the Members of Congress.
Implementing Guidelines. – The Department of Budget and Management shall issue the necessary guidelines for the implementation of the salary adjustment herein authorized.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect on January 1, 1997.
